name: Anna-Julia Storch
headline: Co-founder & CEO @Dryft | Data Science @Stanford | Threshold Venture Fellow | CDTM | Athlete
location: Palo Alto, United States of America
summary:
My primary goal in life is to be as useful as possible. 
I grew up competing in Alpine Ski Racing internationally for many years while living hundreds of kilometers away from the alps. Showing others what is possible even if you don’t have the perfect/typical background is what drives me. Back when I was a ski racer and now in entrepreneurship. 

I've helped build up multiple entrepreneurial ventures from 0 to 1. For example, I was one of the first 2 people joining Kyte and I also founded a new business line for a multinational company with multi-million dollar revenues as my first full-time job.

I have endless curiosity and love meeting ultra ambitious and unique (!) individuals with a sense of urgency.
